title: ImpersonationBanner test: a late identity read escapes to the real network when afterEach unstubs fetch before RTL cleanup (CI flake)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

Category: ② test reliability with a named location. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

**Business reason.** This test goes red at random on unrelated PRs. Each time, someone has to work out that the failure is not theirs and re-run the job. That cost a card thread a full investigation on PR #30417, whose diff never touches the banner.

**What happens.**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx` failed once in `Test UI (7/16)` on PR #30417, job 127192655114, head `53cf42ca`.
- The failing case was "a LATER impersonation, after a stop that worked, is not reported as a failed stop".
- The network guard reported a real socket at `http://localhost:3000/api/v1/data/sys_user/usr_admin`.
- The re-run passed (job 127207615001).
- Locally the file passed 8 of 8 runs on that branch and 4 of 4 on base `fe835b49`.

**Mechanism.** This is read from the test file, not reproduced. The component sends its own `sys_user` read through `createAuthenticatedFetch`. The file's `afterEach` calls `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` before RTL `cleanup()` runs. A read that lands late therefore reaches the real `fetch`. This is the shape the guard's message describes (objectui#7439): cleanup must run before unstubbing, or the double should be installed once at module scope and left up for the whole file.

**Expected.** The file never reaches the network: the fetch double is torn down only after cleanup, or it stays up for the whole file. Add a pin that a late read still hits the double.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. The fix is test-only, in this one file.

Dedupe: I searched `ImpersonationBanner network escape` and `ImpersonationBanner unstubAllGlobals`. Neither found an open card.
